title: Implement visitor check-in/out and temporary credentials

environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-VIS-002-AC01.finding: The existing BIO-VIS-001 check-in service enforces configured approval and evidence requirements; this story preserves and delegates to that implementation.

BIO-VIS-002-AC02.finding: A visitor credential has bounded expiry and enumerated scope and is persisted only with a real activated BIO-CRD-005 card.

BIO-VIS-002-AC03.finding: Checkout revokes the credential and deactivates its backing card before the one-way visitor checkout; retry remains idempotent and fail-closed.

BIO-VIS-002-AC04.finding: Read-time evaluation distinguishes an arrived visitor in overstay from a never-arrived expired preregistration.

BIO-VIS-002-AC05.finding: History combines visitor lifecycle and credential records; grant, revoke and reconciliation mutations are audit-gated with atomic stable-event deduplication.

BIO-VIS-002-AC06.finding: The packaged visitor route delegates checkout to the BIO-VIS-002 orchestrator without duplicate routing or visitor-page redesign.

commands.result: UNAVAILABLE in acceptance sandbox: VSTest loopback socket bind denied; exact-commit builder evidence records 47/47 PASS

final_acceptance.reason: All six acceptance criteria map to exact-commit implementation, tests, builder evidence and independent QA/security PASS reviews. Fresh structural, traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass; executable .NET coverage is commit-bound because this sandbox denies the VSTest loopback socket.
